name: Project Feature Bento
description: Dark project-management feature bento: Kanban Boards (tilted story cards with status pills), VCS Automations (three version-control node tiles joined by flowing dashed connectors), Collaborative Docs (a doc card with floating comment tags), Sprints (progress rows with the active sprint filling its bar), and Speed & Efficiency (keyboard keycaps). All artwork is token CSS/SVG.
interactions: cards fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-pfb-up, staggered per card)
VCS connector lines flow: dashed strokes animate stroke-dashoffset (wpmn-pfb-dash, 1.4s linear infinite)
the active sprint bar fills width 0 -> 62% when in view (1s cubic-bezier)
cards brighten their border + lift 3px on hover; arrow buttons fill on hover
prefers-reduced-motion: dash flow + bar fill off, reveals rendered in place
